purpose: Candidate design/furniture merchants to test for token-less Shopify Storefront MODEL_3D census viability. Membership here is a HYPOTHESIS; only merchants that PASS the live capability probe (npm run avatar:shopify:model3d:capability) become census-eligible. No viability is asserted without live evidence.

candidates.note: token-less products query responded 200 in first probe

probe_policy: For each candidate fetch /sitemap.xml, find product sitemaps, take a small sample of product handles, and run the token-less product(handle) Storefront query. Record: is_shopify_sitemap, storefront_api_ok, sample_products_resolved, model3d_seen_in_sample, http statuses. Persist verdicts and evidence only; never persist model source URLs or a catalogue mirror.
persistence_policy: Persist only merchant origin, viability verdict, sampled counts and MODEL_3D-seen booleans. No model source URLs.
